procedure check_x (flag IN OUT VARCHAR2) IS
-- This procedure checks for at least one 'X'
 temp_rec_no VARCHAR2(5);
begin
 flag := 'FALSE';
 temp_rec_no := :system.trigger_record;
 go_record('1');
 loop
 if :s_selection = 'X'
 then

 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE'
 then
 exit;
 end if;
 down;
 end loop;

end;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_CONTACT_NAME
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure get_contact_name (direction_flag in VARCHAR2) is
 tmp_save_consignee VARCHAR2(10);
 tmp_field_left VARCHAR2(4);
 tmp_count number;
 chp_sysdate DATE; 
begin
 -- IM:5412; AV; 05/08/2011
 begin
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,chp_sysdate);
 else
 chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if; 
 exception
 when others then 
 tackle_error('TimeZone Convert');
 check_package_failure;
 end; 
 -- 
 begin
 select name, consignee_id, customer_id
 into :hosp_info.name, :hosp_info.consignee_id,
 :hosp_info.customer_id
 from consignee
 where consignee_id = :shipped_to
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in getting consignee info');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 --
 -- Get contact person name and phone number
 --
 begin
 select substr(first_name || ' ' || last_name,1,50),
 day_phone_no
 into :s_contact_person, :hosp_info.phone_no
 from vserv_contacts
 where customer_id = :hosp_info.customer_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and rownum <= 1
 and chp_sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,chp_sysdate+1);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in getting contact info');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 --
 -- Count the number of units belong to this consignee
 --
 tmp_count := 0;
 tmp_save_consignee := :shipped_to;
 tmp_field_left := :system.trigger_record;
 loop
 tmp_count := tmp_count + 1;
 if direction_flag = 'DW'
 then
 down;
 else
 up;
 end if;
 exit when name_in('shipped_to') != tmp_save_consignee or
 name_in('shipped_to') is null or
 (:system.trigger_record = 1 and direction_flag = 'UP');
 end loop;
 if :hosp_product_info.unit_id is null
 then
 clear_record;
 end if;
 --
 -- Need to add one more to count since, we miss the first record
 --
 if direction_flag = 'UP' and
 :system.trigger_record = 1
 then
 :s_avail_qty := tmp_count + 1;
 else
 :s_avail_qty := tmp_count;
 end if;
 go_record(tmp_field_left);
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_HOSP_INFO
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure get_hosp_info is
 assigned_value VARCHAR2(1) := 'N';
 chp_sysdate DATE;
 cursor c1(pl_sysdate IN DATE) is
 select distinct shipped_to, unit_id, coll_date, product_type,
 product_code, aliquot, blood_type, exp_date,
 inventory_class, insert_date
 from shipped_products s
 where trunc(shipped_date) between
 (trunc(sysdate)-:shipment_age) and trunc(sysdate)
 and s.chapter_id = :s_chapter_id
 and exp_date > sysdate
 and transfer_reserve_flag is null
 and stock_state = 'DL'
 and inventory_class != 'AD'
 and shipped_to != :s_consignee_id
 and product_type = :item_info.product_type
 and not exists (select 'x' from transfer_products
 where unit_id = s.unit_id
 and chapter_id = s.chapter_id
 and pick_slip_status!='CL'
 and product_code = s.product_code)
 and exists (select 'x'
 from consignee
 where consignee_id = shipped_to
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and customer_id like '%-RG%')
 and ((:sub_ok = 'N' and
 blood_type in (:s_min_abo,:s_max_abo)) or
 (:sub_ok = 'Y' and
 (blood_type in (:s_min_abo,:s_max_abo) or
 blood_type in
 (select compatible_abo
 from vserv_abo_compatibility
 where request_abo in (:s_min_abo,:s_max_abo)
 and product_type = :item_info.product_type
 and pl_sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,pl_sysdate+1)))))
 and (not exists (select 'x'
 from pick_slip_product_attr pa,
 pick_slip_products psp, boxes bx
 where pa.unit_id = s.unit_id
 and pa.chapter_id = s.chapter_id
 and pa.product_code = s.product_code
 and psp.pick_slip_id=pa.pick_slip_id
 and bx.box_id=psp.box_id
 and bx.shipment_no=s.shipment_no
 /* Modified by HCL Consuting */
 and psp.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and bx.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id)
 /* Modified by HCL Consuting */
 and not exists (select 'x'
 from pick_slip_product_antgns pan,
 pick_slip_products psp, boxes bx
 where pan.unit_id = s.unit_id
 and pan.chapter_id = s.chapter_id
 and pan.product_code = s.product_code
 and psp.pick_slip_id=pan.pick_slip_id
 and bx.box_id=psp.box_id
 and bx.shipment_no=s.shipment_no
 /* Modified by HCL Consuting */
 and psp.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and bx.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id))
 /* Modified by HCL Consuting */
 order by insert_date desc, shipped_to;
/*
 and (not exists (select 'x'
 from product_attributes pa
 where unit_id = s.unit_id
 and chapter_id = s.chapter_id
 and product_code = s.product_code) and
 not exists (select 'x'
 from unit_antigens pa
 where unit_id = s.unit_id
 and chapter_id = pa.chapter_id
 and test_id != 'ABORH'
 and test_result = 'N'))
*/
begin
 -- IM:5412; AV; 05/08/2011
 begin
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,chp_sysdate);
 else
 chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if; 
 exception
 when others then 
 tackle_error('TimeZone Convert');
 check_package_failure;
 end; 
 -- 
 go_block('hosp_product_info');
 clear_block(NO_VALIDATE);
 for c1_rec in c1(chp_sysdate)
 loop
 ----
 ---- modified for both the schemes to coexists
 ----


 assigned_value := 'Y';
 :hosp_product_info.shipped_to := c1_rec.shipped_to;
 :hosp_product_info.unit_id := c1_rec.unit_id;
 
 ----
 ---- chk_digit_query returns the chk_digit for the unit
 ----
 :hosp_product_info.chk_digit := chk_digit_query(c1_rec.unit_id,
 c1_rec.coll_date,:GLOBAL.chapter_id);
 
 :hosp_product_info.coll_date := c1_rec.coll_date;
 :hosp_product_info.product_type := c1_rec.product_type;
 :hosp_product_info.product_code := c1_rec.product_code;
 :hosp_product_info.aliquot := c1_rec.aliquot;
 :hosp_product_info.blood_type := c1_rec.blood_type;
 :hosp_product_info.exp_date := c1_rec.exp_date;
 :hosp_product_info.inventory_class := c1_rec.inventory_class;
 
 abo_product_description(:hosp_product_info.chk_digit);
 down;
 end loop;
 if assigned_value = 'Y'
 then
 clear_record;
 first_record;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: ATTRIBUTE_ANTIGEN_MATCH
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure attribute_antigen_match is
 unit_str VARCHAR2(2000) := '';
 order_str VARCHAR2(2000) := '';
 assigned_value VARCHAR2(1) := 'N';
 chp_sysdate DATE;
cursor ordered is
 select antigen_id || '-N:' ordered_string,1
 from order_item_antigens
 where order_no = :ctrl_blk_1.order_no
 and item_no = :item_info.item_no
 and chapter_id = :s_chapter_id
 union
 select attrib_group || '-' || attrib_code || ':' ordered_string,2
 from order_item_attributes
 where order_no = :ctrl_blk_1.order_no
 and item_no = :item_info.item_no
 and chapter_id = :s_chapter_id
order by 2,1;
cursor product_selected(pl_sysdate IN DATE) is
 select distinct shipped_to, unit_id, coll_date, product_type,
 product_code, aliquot, blood_type, exp_date, inventory_class
 from shipped_products sh
 where trunc(shipped_date) between
 (trunc(sysdate)-:shipment_age) and trunc(sysdate)
 and chapter_id = :s_chapter_id
 and exp_date >= sysdate
 and inventory_class != 'AD'
 and transfer_reserve_flag is null
 and stock_state = 'DL'
 and shipped_to != :s_consignee_id
 and product_type = :item_info.product_type 
 and not exists (select 'x' from transfer_products
 where unit_id = sh.unit_id
 and chapter_id = sh.chapter_id
 and pick_slip_status!='CL'
 and product_code = sh.product_code)
 and exists (select 'x'
 from consignee
 where consignee_id = shipped_to
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and customer_id like '%-RG%')
 and ((:sub_ok = 'N' and
 blood_type in (:s_min_abo,:s_max_abo)) or
 (:sub_ok = 'Y' and
 ( blood_type in (:s_min_abo,:s_max_abo) or
 blood_type in
 (select compatible_abo
 from vserv_abo_compatibility
 where request_abo in (:s_min_abo,:s_max_abo)
 and product_type = :item_info.product_type
 and pl_sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,pl_sysdate+1)))))
 and (exists (select 'x'
 from component_attributes pa
 where unit_id = sh.unit_id
 and chapter_id = sh.chapter_id
 and product_code = sh.product_code
 and exists (select 'x'
 from order_item_attributes
 where order_no = :ctrl_blk_1.order_no
 and item_no = :item_info.item_no
 and chapter_id = :s_chapter_id
 and attrib_group = pa.attrib_group
 and attrib_code = pa.attrib_code
 )) or
 exists (select 'x'
 from unit_antigens pa
 where unit_id = sh.unit_id
 and chapter_id = pa.chapter_id
 and test_id != 'ABORH'
 and test_result = 'N'
 and exists (select 'x'
 from order_item_antigens oi
 where order_no = :ctrl_blk_1.order_no
 and item_no = :item_info.item_no
 and chapter_id = :s_chapter_id
 and oi.antigen_id = pa.test_id
 )) or
exists (select 'x'
 from unit_attributes pa
 where unit_id = sh.unit_id
 and chapter_id = sh.chapter_id
 and exists (select 'x'
 from order_item_attributes
 where order_no = :ctrl_blk_1.order_no
 and item_no = :item_info.item_no
 and chapter_id = :s_chapter_id
 and attrib_group = pa.attrib_group
 and attrib_code = pa.attrib_code
 )));
 cursor unit (pcur_unit_id in varchar2,
 pcur_coll_date in date,
 pcur_product_code in varchar2) is
 select distinct test_id||'-'||test_result||':' unit_string,1
 from unit_antigens
 where unit_id = pcur_unit_id
 and coll_date = pcur_coll_date
 and chapter_id = :s_chapter_id
 and test_id != 'ABORH'
 and test_result = 'N'
 and exists (select 'x'
 from order_item_antigens
 where order_no = :ctrl_blk_1.order_no
 and item_no = :item_info.item_no
 and chapter_id = :s_chapter_id
 and test_result = 'N'
 and antigen_id = unit_antigens.test_id)
 union
 select distinct attrib_group||'-'||attrib_code||':'unit_string,2
 from component_attributes pa
 where unit_id = pcur_unit_id
 and coll_date = pcur_coll_date
 and product_code = pcur_product_code
 and chapter_id = :s_chapter_id
 and exists (select 'x'
 from order_item_attributes oi
 where order_no = :ctrl_blk_1.order_no
 and item_no = :item_info.item_no
 and chapter_id = :s_chapter_id
 and oi.attrib_group = pa.attrib_group
 and oi.attrib_code = pa.attrib_code)
 union
 select distinct attrib_group||'-'||attrib_code||':'unit_string,2
 from unit_attributes pa
 where unit_id = pcur_unit_id
 and coll_date = pcur_coll_date
 and chapter_id = :s_chapter_id
 and exists (select 'x'
 from order_item_attributes oi
 where order_no = :ctrl_blk_1.order_no
 and item_no = :item_info.item_no
 and chapter_id = :s_chapter_id
 and oi.attrib_group = pa.attrib_group
 and oi.attrib_code = pa.attrib_code)
 order by 2,1;
begin
 -- IM:5412; AV; 05/08/2011
 begin
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,chp_sysdate);
 else
 chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if; 
 exception
 when others then 
 tackle_error('TimeZone Convert');
 check_package_failure;
 end; 
 -- 
 go_block('hosp_product_info');
 clear_block(NO_VALIDATE);
 order_str := '';
 for order_rec in ordered
 loop
 order_str := order_str || order_rec.ordered_string;
 end loop;
 for products_rec in product_selected(chp_sysdate)
 loop
 --
 unit_str := '';
 --
 for unit_rec in unit (products_rec.unit_id,
 products_rec.coll_date,
 products_rec.product_code)
 loop
 unit_str := unit_str || unit_rec.unit_string;
 end loop;
 if order_str = unit_str
 then
 ----
 ---- modified for both the schemes to coexists
 ---- 
 assigned_value := 'Y';
 :hosp_product_info.shipped_to := products_rec.shipped_to;
 :hosp_product_info.unit_id := products_rec.unit_id;
 ----
 ---- chk_digit_query returns the chk_digit for the unit
 ----
 :hosp_product_info.chk_digit := chk_digit_query(products_rec.unit_id,
 products_rec.coll_date,:GLOBAL.chapter_id);

 :hosp_product_info.coll_date := products_rec.coll_date;
 :hosp_product_info.product_type := products_rec.product_type;
 :hosp_product_info.product_code := products_rec.product_code;
 :hosp_product_info.aliquot := products_rec.aliquot;
 :hosp_product_info.blood_type := products_rec.blood_type;
 :hosp_product_info.exp_date := products_rec.exp_date;
 :hosp_product_info.inventory_class := products_rec.inventory_class;
 abo_product_description(:hosp_product_info.chk_digit);
 down;
 end if;
 end loop;
 if assigned_value = 'Y'
 then
 clear_record;
 first_record;
 end if;
end;

 If temp_count = 0 then

 copy('5','system.message_level');

PROCEDURE REPORT_GENERATE(pl_rep_name in varchar2, pl_parm_id in varchar2) IS
parameters VARCHAR2(150) := NULL;
 command VARCHAR2(200) := NULL;
 temp_return number;
 filename varchar2(1000);
 pl_id ParamList;

 rep_dir varchar2(30);
 temp varchar2(40);
 a_port varchar2(40);
 val varchar2(2000);
 repid REPORT_OBJECT;

 rep_status VARCHAR2(20);
 
--for Apps server 
report_id Report_Object;
ReportServerJob VARCHAR2(100);
vc_rep_status VARCHAR2(100);
vjob_id VARCHAR2(100);

 -- Multiple reports server changes;
 l_svr_name VARCHAR2(70);
 l_err_msg VARCHAR2(200);
BEGIN 
 BEGIN 
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF not Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 destroy_parameter_list(pl_id) ;
 end if ;

 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 Message('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name); 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 END IF; 
 END; 
 --message('number -1');
 
/* Get the report server name from the master code table*/
/* -- Commented on 04/12/2012; Ashok; Below code moved to LTRepServer_Lab.pkg

 BEGIN
 Select code_desc into val 
 from master_codes 
 where code_type='OASVR' 
 and code='RPSVR'
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1); 
 Exception
 When no_data_found then
 message('Report server is not defined in the SYSPARM table for REPSVR');
 raise form_trigger_failure; 
 End;
*/ 
--message('number -2');
 -- Added on 04/10/2012 to get least active jobs report server name.
 BC_CHECK_REPSERVER.get_reports_server( out_server_name => l_svr_name,
 out_error_msg => l_err_msg
 );

 IF l_err_msg IS NOT NULL THEN
 message('Err ' || l_err_msg);
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 
 IF l_svr_name IS NULL THEN
 message('Error retrieving Server Name');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 
 ------------
--val:='rep_chdevsrv10_oracleas1'; 
--filename:=:rpt_parm.report_name||'_'||'_'||user;

filename:=pl_rep_name||'_'||pl_parm_id||'_'||LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid||'.pdf';
report_id:= find_report_object('LTREPORTS');
SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_FILENAME,lower(pl_rep_name)); --'vdrinter.rdf');
SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_COMM_MODE,ASYNCHRONOUS);
SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_EXECUTION_MODE,BATCH);
SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_DESTYPE,file);
SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_DESNAME,filename);
SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_DESFORMAT,'pdf');
SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_SERVER,l_svr_name);
SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_OTHER, 'paramform=no');

 add_parameter(pl_id,'P_PARM_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,pl_parm_id) ;
 add_parameter(pl_id,'P_USER',TEXT_PARAMETER,:banner.user_id) ;
 add_parameter(pl_id,'NO_OF_COPIES',TEXT_PARAMETER,'1');
 add_parameter(pl_id,'P_CHAPTER_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:global.chapter_id);
 add_parameter(pl_id,'PRINT_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,NULL);
 add_parameter(pl_id,'HEADER_YN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'N');
 --add_parameter(pl_id,'DELETE_AFTER_PRINT_FLAG',TEXT_PARAMETER,:rpt_parm.delete_after_print_flag);
 --add_parameter(pl_id,'AUTO_PRINT_FLAG',TEXT_PARAMETER,:rpt_parm.auto_print_flag);
 add_parameter(pl_id,'RPT_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,upper(pl_rep_name));
 
ReportServerJob:=run_report_object(report_id,pl_id);
vjob_id := substr(reportserverjob,length(l_svr_name)+2);
vc_rep_status := REPORT_OBJECT_STATUS(ReportServerJob);

message('Report Submitted ... ');

/* Commented on 04/12/2012; Ashok -- Only submit the report; Cronjob will update the status of the report

WHILE vc_rep_status in ('RUNNING','OPENING_REPORT','ENQUEUED', null)
LOOP
vc_rep_status:=REPORT_OBJECT_STATUS(ReportServerJob);
END LOOP;

--message('number -3');

IF vc_rep_status='FINISHED' THEN
 
 update rpt_parm set report_status = 'C'
 where user_name = decode(substr(LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid,1,3),'OPS',substr(LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid,5),LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid)
 and lower(report_name) = lower(pl_rep_name)
 and parm_id=pl_parm_id;
 
 --WEB.SHOW_DOCUMENT('/reports/rwservlet/getjobid'|| vjob_id ||'?server='||val,'_blank');
 message('Report generated');
ELSE
message ('Report failed with error message '|| vc_rep_status);
END IF;
*/

update rpt_parm 
 set rep_job_id=vjob_id ,
 rep_server = l_svr_name
 where upper(report_name)=upper(pl_rep_name) 
 and user_name = decode(substr(LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid,1,3),'OPS',substr(LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid,5),LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid)
 and parm_id=pl_parm_id;
 
:system.message_level:=15;
commit; 
:system.message_level:=0;
END;
